title: ATESI-SBEC: Auditable Thermal Energy Storage Intelligence for Smart-Building Energy Prediction and Carbon-Aware Optimization (code and results)
description: Open-source repository providing a fully reproducible implementation of ATESI-SBEC: leakage-safe one-hour-ahead building demand forecasting, LIME attribution with consistency and dose-response checks, DiCE counterfactual recourse under envelope and coupling constraints, and receding-horizon mixed-integer thermal-storage dispatch with time-of-use cost and carbon accounting, evaluated on a public six-year smart-building dataset.
